concerns.text: Task T021a (Statistical Power Calculation) is marked as missing/failed in the analyze report, yet no active task exists to implement the logic or generate the `data/processed/power_analysis.json` artifact required by SC-006. The spec requires measuring power against a target of ≥ 0.8 (SC-006), but the implementation task is broken.

Task T024a (Core Correlation Logic) is marked as missing/failed. While T024 (Analysis Runner) exists, it depends on T024a to produce `data/processed/results_correlation.json`. Without a working T024a, FR-006 (Spearman correlation) and SC-001 (Significance measurement) cannot be satisfied.

Task T017a (Missing Metadata Proportion) is blocked by T018 (Data Export), which is also marked as failed. SC-002 requires measuring the proportion of dependencies with missing metadata. The dependency chain is broken with no active task to produce the input data or the metric output.

Task T029a (Variance Calculation) is marked as failed. SC-003 requires measuring variance in correlation coefficients across categories. The task description mentions appending to `results_correlation.json` but lacks a verified implementation step to generate this artifact, leaving SC-003 untestable.

Task T032 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked as failed. The spec requires a sensitivity analysis for the 'unmaintained' threshold (Assumptions section). No active task exists to implement the threshold sweep or generate `data/processed/sensitivity_analysis.json`, leaving the robustness check unimplemented.

Task T018 (Data Export) is marked as failed. This task is the critical output for User Story 1 (FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004). Without a working T018 to produce `dependencies_raw.csv`, all downstream tasks (US2, US3) and success criteria (SC-001 through SC-006) are blocked.
